cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: her living room with a deep sofa — tears a finished page out of a notebook; a starship galley and mess hall — pours tea from a small teapot into a cup on the table; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; A modern apartment reading nook at night — She reaches for the little prism at the end of a chapter and splashes a rectangle of lamplight across the wall; a Peking opera dressing room — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips; a red carpet and award hall with camera flashes — takes a bite from a cloud of pink cotton candy on a stick; A nearly empty modern outdoor terrace above a hillside funicular at blue hour — She watches the first carriage lights climb the hill and sips hot ginger tea while she waits for her ride; the Changban Bridge memorial — kneeling on the ground; inside a general's command tent — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — holds a masquerade mask on a stick up over her eyes; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — reclining on her back; a busy street market of food stalls and strung bulbs — standing
